C0184.title: Nine Defendants Sentenced for Paid Negative Review Deletion Services
C0184.summary: In June 2024, China Court reported a case heard by the Kaihua County People's Court in Zhejiang involving illegal paid negative review deletion services. Lin and others exploited platform loopholes to remove negative reviews for merchants for a fee, disrupting the platform review mechanism and market order. The court convicted nine defendants of illegal business operations, sentencing them to prison terms from five years to six months and imposing fines from 300,000 yuan to 23,000 yuan.
